title: Week of July 27–Aug 2
subtitle: Week 7 · Block 2 Week 3 (final build) — cross 20 miles, own the new top sets, one last honest push before the Aug 3 deload.
goals: Cross 20 miles: ~20.25 mi planned, up from the 18.81 you actually ran (summed from YOUR entered miles — Strava's treadmill numbers undercount ~20%, so the app log is the arbiter, exactly as you flagged Thursday).

Own, don't chase: incline holds 155 (your PR), push press holds 140 (you called it your limit — same target, crisper reps), front squat holds 145 until the form feels locked. The only earned nudges: paused DL 235, split leg press 270, hip thrust 160.
Tuesday goes to 7×3 min — you said 6 felt easier at a faster pace, so one more rep at the same descending 6:55→6:25 range. Everything else strict Z2.
Saturday surprise format #2: circuit rounds. Fresh max pull-up benchmark first — you hit 18, chase 19 — then the same movements as rounds. Parallel-bar dips lead each dip set, bench when form falls.
Pallof press is out of the rotation (no bands) — V-ups in for core variety.
192.5–192.6 and tracking to 189.9 by Aug 14. Protein ≥180g, eat to the SMART goal. Deload starts Aug 3 — earn it this week.
review: Excellent build week — arguably the best of the block. What you logged: Incline Bench 155×6, a real PR ('close to the limit' — so we hold it and own it, unspotted rules apply). Push Press 140 ('definitely my limit... aim for the same thing next week' — done, 140 holds). Front Squat 145 top set, tough with form starting to go — right call not forcing more; 145 holds until it's crisp, 150 waits for after the deload. Paused Deadlift 225 'felt much better than last week' — that earns the 235 nudge for the final build week, with the same escape hatch (knee or back talks → drop to 225/205). Split leg press at 250 with 'way more focus and stability required... can probably step this up' → 270 top set. Friday pull-ups up to 3×9 on your own, and Saturday's benchmark hit exactly the 18 we chased (18/10/7) — this week: 19. Parallel-bar dips are coming in nicely; the plan now programs them explicitly (bars first, bench when form falls). Running: you ran 18.81 mi by your entered miles — Mon 1.5, Tue 4.7, Wed 1.5, Thu 4.5, Fri 1.0, Sat 1.5, Sun 4.11. Noted and locked in: weekly mileage is summed from YOUR app-entered distances, not Strava, whose treadmill readings ran ~20% low this week (your Tue 4.7 showed as ~3.9 there). Soreness at 'acceptable range' by week's end is exactly where a week-3 build should land — this week adds ~7.5% mileage and almost no new load, then the Aug 3–9 deload (lifts −10–15% off tops, mileage ~14) cashes it all in. Scale: 195.3 → 192.5 over two weeks, ahead of pace for 189.9 by Aug 14. Leaner and stronger, like you said — the plan's job this week is to bank it, not to get greedy.
